title: Admission of international students – How to apply
evidence: First application call for most programs opens 15 September 2026 and closes 15 November 2026; bachelor's entry normally requires 12 years of schooling; master's applicants need a relevant bachelor’s degree and program-specific requirements; English-taught degrees use apply.unipd.it.

title: International students – 2027/28 applications (DiSSGeA)
evidence: Lists History (Bachelor’s), Classical Languages and Literatures and Ancient History, Historical Sciences, Landscape Studies, Religious Studies, Local Development and Mobility Studies, and gives calls 15 Sep–15 Nov 2026, 1 Dec 2026–1 Mar 2027, and 1 Apr–1 Jun 2027 for EU and non-EU residents in Italy only.

title: Deadlines – Admission to Laurea Magistrale with foreign qualification
evidence: For MSc September 2027 intake, general application periods include 1 Oct–1 Dec 2026 early-bird and 12–28 Jan 2027; an additional 1–18 Mar 2027 call is restricted to EEA applicants and eligible non-EEA residents in Italy. Fees are €50 early-bird or €150 standard, for up to two programs. Architecture/Design has a separate cycle section.

title: Engineering BSc enrolment – 2027/28
evidence: Publishes the 2027/28 Engineering BSc enrolment calendar: first phase 3 May–10 June 2027 (limited eligibility and excludes English-taught programmes); the second phase has preferences due 17 June followed by rankings and enrolment dates through 30 June; the third phase has preferences due 22 July and rankings through 4 August; the fourth phase has preferences due 26 August and rankings through 8 September. The first tuition instalment is €880.04, with ISEE-based reductions possible. Dates are CEST.

title: Documents required by the Admissions Office – English certification
evidence: Gives 2027/28 English certificate scores for MSc applicants: TOEFL iBT at least 78 for tests through 20 Jan 2026 and at least 4.5 from 21 Jan 2026; TOEIC at least 785 Listening/Reading and 310 Speaking/Writing; IELTS at least 6; specified Cambridge, Trinity, Pearson and LanguageCert scores. Applicants whose bachelor’s was taught in English for at least three years may be exempt if their university certifies at least 75% of courses were in English.

title: HySET applications open for the 2027–2029 edition
evidence: Official announcement says the fifth HySET edition covers academic years 2027–2029 and opened 1 October 2026; the application deadline is 15 November 2026. HySET is jointly coordinated by Politecnico di Torino and Politecnico di Milano with international consortium partners.

title: HySET admission requirements
evidence: Requires a relevant bachelor’s degree of at least 180 ECTS in listed engineering/science fields; minimum English evidence is TOEFL iBT 90 with at least 21 in each section, IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 each section, or Cambridge 160 (higher threshold for a TU/e destination). Selection is scored on academic achievements, background relevance, references/video, and experience. The current page states a 2027–29 call is open.

title: HySET programme structure and awarded degrees
evidence: Describes a 120-ECTS four-semester master’s, with first-year entry allocated between Politecnico di Torino and Politecnico di Milano and second-year mobility to a consortium partner. Depending on the partner route, students earn two master’s degrees; the programme focuses on the hydrogen value chain.

title: HySET frequently asked questions – language of instruction
evidence: States that the entire HySET programme is taught in English.

title: HySET continuation beyond 2026 – funding and admissions
evidence: States that funding for the 2027 cohort had not yet been secured and future scholarships depend on a successful external funding award; scholarship availability is not guaranteed. The separate self-funded page states annual fees of €4,500 for European students and €9,000 for non-European students.

title: HySET self-funded students – tuition fees
evidence: Lists self-funded tuition as €4,500 per year (€9,000 total) for European students and €9,000 per year (€18,000 total) for non-European students; living costs and travel between partner universities are excluded. Payment details/deadlines are to be provided later.

title: International admissions call 2027/28 – English MSc programs
evidence: Department call lists MSc Computer Science, Data Science and Business Informatics, and Informatics for Digital Health. For non-EU applicants residing abroad it gives an application deadline of 1 February 2027 (Anywhere on Earth), notification on 1 March 2027, and a €30 fee per application (up to two). Tuition for 2027/28 is not specified; the call says annual fees are usually announced in June. No seats or acceptance rates are published in this call.

title: Master programme in Computer Science
evidence: Official page describes the English-taught MSc Computer Science and links to international admissions. Cycle availability is confirmed separately by the 2027/28 department call.

title: Master programme in Data Science and Business Informatics
evidence: Official page describes the English-taught MSc. Cycle availability is confirmed separately by the 2027/28 department call.

title: Master programme in Informatics for Digital Health
evidence: Describes an English-taught open-admission MSc and links to foreign-student enrollment for AY 2027/28. The department call confirms cycle availability.

title: Application and Admission – 2027/28
evidence: Publishes 2027/28 application rounds for international candidates and a €40 fee for up to two program applications; English certificates are generally B2 unless exempt; program details and eligibility must be checked individually.

title: UniGeApply International Admissions
evidence: 2027/28 non-EU visa preselection is expected mid-December 2026 through end-March 2027; exact dates await publication. €30 fee covers up to two assessment applications. English-taught programs do not require Italian.

title: 28DIGITAL Master School at UniTrento – technical majors and 2027/28 intake
source_type: Official department and program admissions page
evidence: Describes the UniTrento 28DIGITAL offer as two-year, 120-ECTS double-degree master’s study with technical majors in Information Engineering (Cloud and Network Infrastructures and HPC; Intelligent Chips and Systems), Computer Science (Cyber Security, Data Science, Fintech, Human-Computer Interaction & Design with extended reality), and Artificial Intelligence Systems (Artificial Intelligence with Affective Computing). For the 2027/28 intake it lists three application periods: 31 Oct–11 Feb open to EU/EEA/CH and non-EU applicants; 11 Feb–15 Apr open to EU/EEA/CH and non-EU Italian residents, with visa timing limitations; and 15 Apr–1 Jun open to EU/EEA/CH and non-EU Italian residents. The page says not all trajectories may be available in period two, central selection is handled by 28DIGITAL, and consortium scholarships are first-come-first-served. UniTrento's additional double-degree scholarships are for second-year entrants who receive no other 28DIGITAL grant; their call is indicatively published in August.

title: 28DIGITAL Master School – 2027 admission dates and criteria
evidence: Lists 2027 application periods as 30 Oct 2026–31 Jan 2027, 1 Feb–18 Apr 2027 and 19 Apr–31 May 2027, with applicant-category/visa restrictions by round. States all 28DIGITAL programmes are taught in English; applicants need a relevant bachelor’s degree of at least 180 ECTS and English proficiency, generally IELTS 6.5 with section minimums or TOEFL iBT scores depending on test scale/date. The University of Trento department’s 2027/28 intake page publishes different round boundaries; treat the university-level date comparison as conflicting and use each programme’s central portal before applying.

title: 28DIGITAL Master School – tuition fees and scholarships
source_type: Official joint-master fees and funding page
evidence: Lists €75 non-refundable application fee per application, €250 non-refundable registration deposit credited to first-semester tuition, and tuition of €6,000 per academic year for EU/EEA citizens or €18,000 for non-EU/EEA citizens. General merit-based awards include full or half tuition waivers; additional excellence scholarships with living allowance are restricted to EU/EEA and associated-country citizens in selected programs. Period 1, 2 and 3 tuition-payment expected deadlines are 31 May, 30 June and 19 July 2027, respectively.

title: Cyber Security (CSES) – 28DIGITAL Master School
evidence: Describes the two-year Cyber Security master’s track, names the University of Trento as a partner, gives relevant bachelor fields and states the 2027 first-period deadline is 31 January. The programme page says central 28DIGITAL selection applies.

title: Data Science (DSC) – 28DIGITAL Master School
evidence: Describes the Data Science master’s, two-year entry/exit double-degree structure, relevant bachelor fields, at least 60 ECTS in computer science/computer architecture and 30 ECTS in mathematics, and the 2027 first-period deadline of 31 January. UniTrento lists itself as an exit point for this track.

title: Fintech (FT) – 28DIGITAL Master School
evidence: Describes the Fintech master’s, relevant bachelor fields, two-year mobility structure and 2027 first-period deadline of 31 January. UniTrento lists itself as an entry and exit point for this track.

title: Human-Computer Interaction and Design with Extended Reality (HCID/XR)
evidence: Describes the double-degree master’s, relevant bachelor fields and experience, and the 2027 first-period deadline of 31 January. UniTrento lists itself as an exit point for this track.

title: Cloud and Networking Infrastructure and HPC (CNIHPC)
evidence: Describes the two-year double-degree master’s, relevant bachelor preparation and the 2027 first-period deadline of 31 January. UniTrento lists itself as an entry and exit point for this track.

title: Intelligent Chips and Systems (ICS) – 28DIGITAL Master School
evidence: Describes the two-year master's, relevant bachelor fields, minimum 40 ECTS in ICT and 20 ECTS in mathematics, and the 2027 first-period deadline of 31 January. UniTrento lists itself as an exit point for this track.

title: Artificial Intelligence with Affective Computing (AIAC)
evidence: Describes the two-year double-degree master's, relevant bachelor fields and expected background in programming, algorithms, mathematics and statistics, and the 2027 first-period deadline of 31 January. UniTrento lists itself as an entry and exit point for this track.

title: Preliminary evaluation of international qualifications
evidence: States that applications for international qualifications seeking 2027/28 bachelor’s or master’s admission start in December 2026; exact calls and dates are to be published later.

title: Buddhism and Asian Religions – programme and 2027/28 admission
evidence: States that the MSc activates in 2027/28; level MSc, LM-64, Venice, English, two years/120 credits and open admission. The admission page says detailed 2027/28 procedures and deadlines will be updated in March 2027; the enrolment page requires B2 English and adequate preparation.

title: Financial aid for high-achieving international students
evidence: For 2027/28 lists 8 bachelor scholarships of €10,000/year for three years and 20 master’s scholarships of €10,000/year for two years. Ranking factors include CGPA at least 85%, motivational video, reference letters and language evidence; the complete call with exact deadlines is expected in late fall.

title: Admission A.Y. 2027-28 – Mechatronics Engineering
evidence: MSc Mechatronics Engineering, two years/120 credits, taught in English; lists non-EU visa applicant windows 9–27 Nov 2026, 11–25 Jan 2027, 8–22 Feb 2027 and resident window 5 Jul–6 Sep 2027; €30 application fee, 60 non-EU-abroad seats plus 4 Marco Polo places, B2 English, curricular requirements and document list.

title: Aims and scopes – Mechatronics Engineering
evidence: States the program is taught entirely in English; the current cycle-specific admission page separately confirms 2027/28 availability.

title: Enrollment (a.y. 2027/28) – Software: Science and Technology
evidence: Program page specifies open admission for the 2027/28 MSc, bachelor’s qualification, country-specific grade threshold, 24 ECTS in CS/Computer Engineering and 24 ECTS in Mathematics/Physics/Statistics, B2 English evidence and possible interview.

evidence: Publishes AY 2027/28 application intakes from November 2026 to February 2027 and March to April 2027, with results in March and May. Exact day-level deadlines are not supplied on the reviewed page.

title: Computer Science and Engineering – admissions and requirements
evidence: Identifies the MSc and its Intelligent Embedded Systems curriculum as English-taught, with a Bologna-managed local track (15 places) and a 28Digital track (10 places) managed by 28Digital. The shared curricular entry requirements include a relevant first-cycle degree or specified 42 ECTS including at least 18 ECTS in computer science/engineering; B2 English is required for Intelligent Embedded Systems. The 28Digital track is open for 2027/28.

title: Intelligent Embedded Systems – 28Digital track
evidence: For a.y. 2027/28, the English Intelligent Embedded Systems 28Digital track has three application sessions: 30 Oct 2026–31 Jan 2027 for EU/EEA/CH and non-EU applicants; 1 Feb–18 Apr 2027 primarily for EU/EEA/CH and applicants not requiring a residence permit; and 19 Apr–31 May 2027 only for EU/EEA/CH and non-EU applicants not requiring a study visa. Admissions are managed directly by 28Digital. The 28Digital track combines a first-year entry university and a different-country second-year exit university, and grants a double degree plus a 28Digital certificate.
